crossRefs.note: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants…
Joab’s men went out after him, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of…
When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand…
Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”
He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”
translations.bsb: One of Joab’s young men stood near Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!”
translations.kjv: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
translations.asv: And there stood by him one of Joab's young men, and said, He that favoreth Joab, and he that is for David, let him follow Joab.
